logic: Extracted fund name must match or fuzzy-match a fund in private_fund_master.
Required fields such as fund name, date, amount, currency, period, and ending NAV must be present.
Flag capital calls due within 7 calendar days of receipt.
Compare amount due with available cash for the related entity.
Paid-in capital plus unfunded commitment should approximately equal total commitment.
Beginning NAV plus contributions plus distributions plus fees and gains/losses should reconcile to Ending NAV.
Distribution components should reconcile to gross and net distribution.
Raw fund name differs from master name but can be mapped using fund_aliases.
Extraction confidence score below 0.85 triggers review.
